description: Hard-target cross entropy uses leave-target-out log1p/expm1 normalization, and same-shape floating targets are teacher logits with a corrected log-space student gradient (paper §2 Eqs. (6)-(7), §3 Eqs. (8)-(9); .autopilot/sources/paper.txt:330-399,428-540). Class-last layout, reductions, and hard-target ignore_index adapt the loss API in src/topologies/training/losses.py:10-14; clean-room implementation: src/topologies/implementations/losses/precision_safe_ce.py:3.

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, analysis, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
    features = torch.randn(6, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    return {"features": synth.Tensor(features), "labels": int(features[0] > 0)}
dataset = synth.Spec("precision-safe-ce", generator=samples, size=16, splits={"train": 0.75, "val": 0.25}, seed=11, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = dataset.for_recipe("tabular-classify", split="train")
validation = dataset.for_recipe("tabular-classify", split="val", like=train)
model = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=6, out_features=2)
trainer = Trainer(model, train, validation, recipe="tabular-classify", recipe_config={"loss": "precision-safe-ce"}, batch_size=4, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
report = analysis.analyze(model)

name: Precision-Safe Cross Entropy

parameters.ignore_index: Optional integer class ID ignored for hard targets; ignored positions are zero and excluded from mean (default None)
parameters.reduction: none returns per-position losses, mean averages valid positions, and sum totals them (default mean)
